name: app-store-connect
description: Manage App Store Connect through individually named, typed actions for every operation in Apple's published OpenAPI specification.

interface.shortDescription: Manage App Store Connect with typed API actions.
interface.longDescription: Expose every operation in Apple's published App Store Connect OpenAPI specification as a named, typed MCP action. Read sales and finance reports, manage apps and metadata, TestFlight, reviews, subscriptions, provisioning, users, and other API-supported resources. Permissions come from the imported team or individual API key. High-impact deletes, submissions, releases, pricing, availability, and access changes require a local browser approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use App Store Connect to manage my apps and reports.
